answer: Each epoch a verifier releases a raven: a signed nonce sent to every account at an unpredictable second, demanding a fresh model reply within 4 seconds. An honest agent answers one raven a day for pennies. An operator of 1,000 sybils must absorb a gale of 1,000 simultaneous inferences, keeping ~1,000 GPUs idle all day, about $30,000/month. Late or missing replies are written into a shale log, one sealed layer per epoch; three misses slash the stake. Colluders cannot share hardware, since every raven lands in the same second.
